scope: Whole bare opposite-input equality of proven same Boolean/Byte/Int16/Int32/Int64 fields rejects pairs before candidate row allocation

checks.command: cargo test -p tablecraft-query --test retrieval --test grouped_subqueries --test external_table_sources --test external_named_sources --test named --test projection_aliases --test projection_alias_values --test borrowed_join_equality -j2 --locked --offline
cargo test -p tablecraft-cli --test integral_joins --test database_collation --test sqlite_queries -j2 --locked --offline
cargo clippy -p tablecraft-cli --bin tablecraft --test integral_joins --test database_collation --test sqlite_queries -j2 --locked --offline -- -D warnings

counting_note: The 117-test regression batch includes the earlier seven focused tests, superseded by the final eight-test target; only its other 110 tests are added. CLI database-collation tests are counted in the separate UNION record.
review: Both selected input relations finish existing reads/evaluation before equality proof; unavailable/pruned slots and active paired descriptors are respected.
Each visited pair uses the existing comparison service once; NULL Unknown, operand direction and outer-unmatched encounter order are preserved.
Only matches allocate copied candidates; compound predicates and other carriers retain the original eager general evaluator.
Every pair remains metered and cancellable; the implementation remains nested-loop execution.
CLI output is compared with independent read-only SQLite query results; native controls preserve original bytes and selected corruption checks.
test_authoring_corrections: Initial native reused-fixture warning received the established scoped dead_code allowance before accepted strict checks.
